device_entry.name: Gatan电镜相机与能量过滤器系统
device_entry.name_en: Gatan TEM Camera and Energy Filter System
tags: 透射电镜与冷冻电镜成像
device_entry.description: 这是一套用于透射电子显微镜的Gatan成像与能量过滤系统，可管理一台或多台电镜相机，并支持K2类直接电子探测器参数设置、图像采集、分帧保存以及能量过滤器调节。它常用于TEM和冷冻电镜实验中的图像记录、剂量分割采集和零损峰对准。
device_entry.description_en: This is a Gatan imaging and energy-filter system for transmission electron microscopy. It can manage one or more microscope cameras and supports K2-class direct electron detector configuration, image acquisition, frame saving, and energy filter adjustment. It is commonly used in TEM and cryo-EM experiments for image recording, dose-fractionated acquisition, and zero-loss peak alignment.
